authority: Department of Basic Education (single national calendar; coastal/inland unified since 2024)

notes: Educators start 2027-01-11 (50 days incl. educator days)
No public holidays in term (Human Rights Day 2027-03-21 falls after closing, observed 2027-03-22; Good Friday 2027-03-26, Family Day 2027-03-29 fall in the holidays)
Special school holiday 2027-04-26 (Monday before Freedom Day)
Public holidays in term: 2027-04-27 Freedom Day, 2027-06-16 Youth Day (Workers' Day 2027-05-01 falls on a Saturday)
Public holidays in term: 2027-08-09 National Women's Day (Monday), 2027-09-24 Heritage Day (Friday)
Learners close 2027-12-08; educators 2027-12-10 (45 days incl. educator days)

note: Maps ATP term numbers to real dates for scheduling (broadcast slots, term-aware pacing). Reissued annually by the DBE - refresh each year. Extracted from Government Gazette No. 51400, GoN 5429 (15 Oct 2024, proposed-calendar notice; tracked as school_calendar/2027.pdf); gov.za school-calendar page confirms the calendar was published 26 Feb 2025 with these same dates. All per-term day counts recomputed from the dates/holidays and match the gazette summary (48+56+52+43 = 199 learner days, 203 incl. educator days). The gov.za page's 'Term 3: 46 school days, 0 holidays' line contradicts its own dates and the gazette (54 weekdays - 2 public holidays = 52) and is treated as a typo.
